cli.reason: Ships the packaged Service Host recovery change. User CLI commands, JSON output, setup, and trace remain compatible.

service.reason: A replacement execution Host waits for identified still-running previous work and starts on its own once it exits, records process evidence per started task in a v3 receipt, and logs why local execution is paused. Unconfirmed, older non-quiescent, corrupt, and unidentifiable ownership stays fenced. Quiescent receipts keep the v2 shape so a verified rollback still starts; Wake and result contracts are unchanged, so no compatibility floor is raised.
